bibl.note: Thiruvengadathan, A. Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita and His Works: A Study. Chennai: The Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute, 2002.

T.S. Kuppusvami Sastri references this work in his Sanskrit intro to the Patañjalicarita (issued as a separate publication as a companion to Kāvyamālā 51). See Thiruvengadathan, A. Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita and His Works: A Study. Chennai: The Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute, 2002: p.17. See also New Catalogus Catalogurum (NCC). Vols 1-36: vol. 24, p. 188.
